documents.title: Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Alivus Life Sciences reported Q2 FY27 revenue from operations of INR 682 crores, representing a 16% year-on-year growth driven by generic API and CDMO business expansion. Management reiterated its full-year FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12% and EBITDA margin guidance of 35% to 36%. Phase 1 of the Solapur facility is progressing on schedule and is expected to become operational in Q3 FY27. The company continues to maintain a net debt-free balance sheet with healthy cash reserves. In Q2 FY27, Alivus Life reported a revenue growth of 16.0% YoY to ₹6,820 million, supported by healthy global demand and a 79.9% YoY pick-up in its CDMO business.

guidance.claim: Alivus Life Sciences reiterated its revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12% for FY27.
guidance.quote: So accordingly, we reiterate our FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12%.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA margins to land in the 35% to 36% range for FY27.
guidance.quote: We are confident of delivering EBITDA margins in the 35% to 36% range in FY27.

guidance.claim: The company guides that it will double its CDMO business over the next 3 to 4 years to contribute 12% to 15% of total revenues.
guidance.quote: Except the fact that on CDMO, we have been guiding that we will double the business from where it is today in next 3 to 4 years' time, which would effectively contribute to about between 12% to 15% of the overall revenues is how we are looking at the CDMO business.

guidance.claim: Management expressed confidence in sustaining growth momentum based on capacity expansion and a healthy development pipeline.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, our ongoing capacity expansion and healthy development pipeline give us confidence in sustaining this momentum and delivering consistent growth.

guidance.claim: Alivus Life has guided for FY27 revenue growth of 10% to 12% with growth skewed towards the second half of the fiscal year.
guidance.quote: We are guiding for revenue growth of 10% to 12% in FY '27 with growth skewed towards H2 FY '27.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident of sustaining EBITDA margins between 30% and 32%.
guidance.quote: We also remain confident of sustaining EBITDA margins in the 30% to 32% range.

guidance.claim: The company expects long-term R&D expenditure to stabilize at around 4% of revenue.
guidance.quote: So we should sort of end up at a steady state of around 4%.

demand_outlook.claim: Q2 FY27 revenue from operations grew 16% year-on-year to INR 682 crores, supported by new product launches and healthy demand.
demand_outlook.quote: During quarter 2, revenue from operations stood at INR682 crores, up 16% year-on-year, driven by new product launches and a healthy demand across our existing portfolio.

demand_outlook.claim: Generic API revenue expanded 11% year-on-year in Q2 FY27 due to solid demand across regulated and emerging markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Our generic API business grew 11% year-on-year in Q2, supported by healthy demand across regulated and emerging markets.

demand_outlook.claim: CDMO revenue reached INR 50 crores in Q2 FY27, surging 32.3% quarter-on-quarter and nearly 80% year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: Our CDMO business delivered a robust performance during the quarter, with revenue climbing to INR50 crores, up 32.3% quarter-on-quarter and nearly 80% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the overall pricing environment remains quite stable.
demand_outlook.quote: So the pricing environment, I would say, is quite stable.

demand_outlook.claim: Q2 FY27 revenue grew 16.0% YoY driven by healthy demand across key markets and robust contributions from recent launches.
demand_outlook.quote: Q2FY27 was another strong quarter for us, with revenue growing 16.0% YoY, supported by healthy demand across all key markets and robust contributions from recent launches.

demand_outlook.claim: Non-GPL business grew 26.5% year-on-year due to successful product launches and strong global demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Our non-GPL business delivered strong growth of 26.5% year-on-year, driven by successful new product launches and strong demand across all geographies.

demand_outlook.claim: GPL business performance declined by 52.6% year-on-year in Q1 due to inventory rationalization.
demand_outlook.quote: GPL has been muted as a result of inventory rationalization. And so if you recall, Q4 was pretty strong, and we saw a dip in Q1, a decline of 52.6% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: GPL business growth is expected to remain flattish in FY27 with stronger performance in the second half.
demand_outlook.quote: While growth in the GPL business is expected to remain flattish in FY '27, the business has been historically weighted towards the second half of the year and we expect a similar trend to play out this year, resulting in a stronger H2 performance.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is actively engaged in discussions for 7 new CDMO projects.
demand_outlook.quote: So CDMO, we have active discussions with almost about 7 projects right now, okay?

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Solapur facility is expected to become operational in Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Coming to our expansion plans, the Solapur facility continues to progress as planned and Phase 1 is expected to become operational in Q3 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction of the Taloja R&D center is progressing as planned with schedule target early next year.
capex_expansion.quote: Construction of our R&D center at Taloja is also progressing well, and we hope to be on schedule early next year.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure for Q2 FY27 was INR 105 crores and totaled INR 190 crores for H1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: On the balance sheet and cash flow movement, capex for the quarter was INR105 crores and for the first half, it was INR190 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction of the new R&D facility at Taloja in Navi Mumbai is advancing as planned.
capex_expansion.quote: The construction of new R&D facility at Taloja (Navi Mumbai) is advancing as planned

capex_expansion.claim: The Solapur facility has faced a slight delay but is expected to be operational in early Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: On the capex front, Solapur continues to progress as planned. There's a little bit of a delay, but it's going to be operational in early Q3 of FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction of the R&D center at Taloja has commenced and is progressing on schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: Construction at Taloja, the R&D center has begun in earnest, and it will happen on schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: Alivus Life expects total capex expenditure of approximately INR 540 crores in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: We expect to incur a capex of approximately INR540 crores in FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is adding 160KL capacity at Dahej and 110KL at Ankleshwar.
capex_expansion.quote: So Dahej is getting 160KL and Ankleshwar is getting like 110KL.

margins_costs.claim: Adjusted EBITDA margin for Q2 FY27 was approximately 39.5% after excluding one-time income.
margins_costs.quote: Excluding the onetime income, adjusted EBITDA margin was approximately 39.5%, reflecting improved operating efficiencies.

margins_costs.claim: The company has largely succeeded in passing raw material price inflation on to customers.
margins_costs.quote: Nitin, we have had a price inflation on our raw materials. But largely speaking, we've been able to pass it on to the customers.

margins_costs.claim: Gross Margin for Q2 FY27 reached 64.4%, up 420 bps QoQ and 670 bps YoY due to a favourable product mix.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Margin at 64.4%, was up 420 bps QoQ and 670 bps YoY, on the back of a favourable product mix.

margins_costs.claim: PAT Margin reached 28.9% in Q2 FY27, up 390 bps QoQ and 680 bps YoY.
margins_costs.quote: PAT Margin at 28.9%, was up 390 bps QoQ & 680 bps YoY.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margins reached 60.2% in Q1 FY27, up 510 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: On the profitability front, a favourable product mix and newer launches helped improve gross margins to 60.2%, an increase in 510 basis points year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins improved by 650 basis points year-on-year to 36.6% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Enhanced operational efficiencies and forex gains also supported 650 basis points Y-o-Y improvement in EBITDA margins to 36.6%.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material price increases originated in solvents and have moved to key starting materials.
margins_costs.quote: While we are seeing the raw material prices are going up. And in fact, it started from solvents and then now to KSM.

orders_capacity.claim: Global filings stood at over 630 DMF and CEP filings as of September 30, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Our pipeline remains robust with over 630 DMF and CEP filings globally as on September 30, 2026.

orders_capacity.claim: The high potent API portfolio features 30 active products representing an addressable market size of $86 billion.
orders_capacity.quote: Our high potent API portfolio continues to advance with 30 new products in the active grid, representing a total addressable market of $86 billion.

orders_capacity.claim: Around 90 to 100 out of 160-odd US DMF filings are currently generating commercial revenue.
orders_capacity.quote: So of the 160-odd DMFs that we have in the U.S., we are working on the -- commercially, we have about around 90 to 100 is what is contributing commercially.

orders_capacity.claim: Non-GPL business contributed 79% of overall revenues in Q2 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Non-GPL business now contributes 79% of our overall revenues.

orders_capacity.claim: The company held 617 global DMF and CEP filings as of June 30, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: The pipeline remains robust, with 617 DMF and CEP filings globally as on June 30.

orders_capacity.claim: Current CDMO segment revenues are generated from 5 active projects.
orders_capacity.quote: The current revenue is coming out of 5 projects, okay?

capital_allocation.claim: Alivus Life Sciences maintained its net debt-free status and built cash and investment balances of INR 1,012 crores as of September 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: We continue to remain a net debt-free company, and we have generated a strong free cash flow of INR270 crores leading to cash and cash equivalents, including short-term investments of INR1,012 crores as of September 30, 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: ROICE expanded to around 34%, demonstrating strong asset productivity and disciplined capital allocation.
capital_allocation.quote: ROICE expanded to ~34% – underscoring strong asset productivity and disciplined capital allocation.

capital_allocation.claim: The company recorded capex of INR 85 crores during Q1 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: On the balance sheet and cash flow moment, our capex for the quarter stood at INR85 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Free cash flow generation stood at INR 90 crores for the quarter, bringing cash and short-term investments to INR 880 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated a strong free cash flow of INR90 crores, leading to cash and cash equivalents including short-term investments of INR880 crores as of 30th June 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Alivus Life remains a debt-free company.
capital_allocation.quote: We continue to remain a debt-free company.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical issues like the Middle East conflict present evolving external risks to global trade and operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: So see, this global situation that is getting impacted by the Middle East conflict, okay, has the potential to -- I mean, freight is one issue, but really freight doesn't even if freight has gone up, but it hasn't significantly impacted us.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted ongoing geopolitical uncertainty and war conditions as a key risk affecting raw material prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: The issue is this war situation, and what it's doing to raw material prices.

management_commitments.claim: Phase 1 of the Solapur facility is expected to become operational in Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Coming to our expansion plans, the Solapur facility continues to progress as planned and Phase 1 is expected to become operational in Q3 of FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Management reiterated overall FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12%.
management_commitments.quote: So accordingly, we reiterate our FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12%.

management_commitments.quote: We are confident of delivering EBITDA margins in the 35% to 36% range in FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to build a portfolio of 25 to 30 dossiers over the next 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: So, we will be building -- we've already identified a portfolio of around 25-30 dossiers that would be developed in the next 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: Alivus Life has planned a brownfield addition of ~100KL capacity at Ankleshwar by Q4 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Brownfield API / Intermediate Ankleshwar Planned addition of ~100KL Capacity Q4 FY27

management_commitments.claim: Phase 1 greenfield expansion of ~340 KL capacity at Solapur is scheduled for Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Phase 1 - ~340 KL (Intermediate block and Backward Integration) Q3 FY27

management_commitments.claim: Phase 3 greenfield expansion at Solapur with planned addition of ~535 KL capacity is targeted for FY29.
management_commitments.quote: Phase 3 - Planned addition of ~535 KL FY29

management_commitments.quote: We are guiding for revenue growth of 10% to 12% in FY '27 with growth skewed towards H2 FY '27.

management_commitments.quote: We also remain confident of sustaining EBITDA margins in the 30% to 32% range.

management_commitments.claim: The Solapur facility will become operational in early Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: There's a little bit of a delay, but it's going to be operational in early Q3 of FY '27.

management_commitments.quote: We expect to incur a capex of approximately INR540 crores in FY '27.
